responsibility: Implements rs6000 calling-convention and call-expansion logic. It is responsible for ABI-specific argument classification and advancement, homogeneous aggregate detection, varargs setup and va_arg handling, return-value placement, sibling-call suitability, thunk emission for C++ multiple inheritance, and related builtin folding hooks, making it the main backend source that translates PowerPC ABI rules into GCC argument-passing and call-generation behavior.
